_about.purpose: References supplied by a human or an external tool, each checked against PubMed by scripts/verify_genes.py before it is shown anywhere.
_about.provenance_rule: A suggestion is not evidence. Every entry here records who suggested it, what PubMed actually returned, and what the paper does NOT support. The title, journal, year and DOI shown in the site come from PubMed, never from the suggestion.
_about.status_rule: A confirmed functional reference alone does not make an entry verified. Gene identity for every named gene must also resolve. Entries below therefore mostly move from unverified to partial.

TOM-TOBRFV-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
TOM-TOBRFV-01.supports: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of SlTOM1a and SlTOM3 (sltom1a/sltom3) makes tomato asymptomatic to ToBRFV, with 516-fold lower viral RNA and 25-fold lower coat protein than wild type at 12 days post-inoculation. The abstract uses SlTOM1a, SlTOM1b and SlTOM3, so the draft's SlTOM1a is the paper's own symbol — the title's 'SlTOM1' is the generic form.
TOM-TOBRFV-01.does_not_support: The claimed locus Solyc01g105140 is not shown to map to either symbol. The same paper reports that sltom1a/sltom3 plants remain susceptible to another tobamovirus, so the resistance is virus-specific and must not be presented as broad tobamovirus resistance.

EGG-PRICKLE-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
EGG-PRICKLE-01.supports: Prickle formation in eggplant is governed by a single dominant gene at the PE (Prickly Eggplant) locus on chromosome 6, fine-mapped to a 9233 bp interval holding one candidate: SmLOG1, a LONELY GUY (LOG)-family cytokinin biosynthetic enzyme expressed mainly in immature prickles. CRISPR-Cas9 knockout of SmLOG1 abolished prickles in all tissues. So SmLOG1 is the paper's own symbol and PE is the locus name, not a competing symbol.
EGG-PRICKLE-01.does_not_support: The draft's SmMYB candidates are a different gene and are not supported by this paper. Note also that the causal sequence variation reported here lies only in the non-coding region, with a CAPS marker from a SNP at -735 bp in the SmLOG1 promoter — so the route is promoter editing or marker-assisted selection, not a coding knockout of the natural allele.

TOM-VITD-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
TOM-VITD-01.supports: Editing a tomato gene in the sterol pathway raises provitamin D3 (7-DHC) in the fruit.
TOM-VITD-01.does_not_support: The symbol Sl7-DR2 used in the draft has no NCBI Gene record; the symbol used in the paper still needs to be read off the publication itself.

TOM-TYLCV-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
TOM-TYLCV-01.supports: The mRNA surveillance factor Pelota underlies begomovirus (TYLCV) resistance at the ty-5 locus.
TOM-TYLCV-01.does_not_support: The symbol SlPelo is not what NCBI indexes; the record is PELOTA (101251671). Note the paper is in PLoS Genetics — a suggestion that named Plant Cell was wrong about the journal.

TOM-TYLCV-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
TOM-TYLCV-01.supports: CRISPR/Cas9 editing produces tomato plants resistant to tomato yellow leaf curl virus.
TOM-TYLCV-01.does_not_support: Read the paper before attributing the effect to a specific allele of this entry's gene.

PEP-MILDEW-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
PEP-MILDEW-01.supports: Loss of function in Mlo orthologs reduces powdery mildew (Leveillula taurica) susceptibility in pepper and tomato.
PEP-MILDEW-01.does_not_support: The paper works on Mlo orthologs; the specific CaMLO2 symbol and its locus identity are not established by it.

ONI-TEAR-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (ChatGPT), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
ONI-TEAR-01.supports: Silencing onion lachrymatory factor synthase (LFS) changes the sulfur secondary metabolite profile and lowers lachrymatory factor.
ONI-TEAR-01.does_not_support: It does not validate AcACS1 or AcACS2, which the draft lists alongside AcLFS in the same entry.

CUC-BITTER-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (Gemini), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
CUC-BITTER-01.supports: Shang et al., Science 2014: biosynthesis, regulation and domestication of bitterness in cucumber. Establishes the bitterness pathway and the Bt / Bl / Bi genes whose GenBank records carry the Csa5G157230, Csa5G156220 and Csa6G088690 locus tags.
CUC-BITTER-01.does_not_support: Tissue specificity still has to be read off the paper per gene — Bt acts in fruit and Bl in leaf, so a single 'non-bitter' edit is not one decision but two, with the leaf copy tied to herbivore defence.

WAT-BRIX-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (Gemini), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
WAT-BRIX-01.supports: A tonoplast sugar transporter (ClTST2) underlies a sugar-accumulation QTL in watermelon; includes its upstream regulator.
WAT-BRIX-01.does_not_support: It does not characterise ClSWEET3 or ClLCYB, which the draft listed in the same entry.

EGG-BROWN-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (Gemini), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
EGG-BROWN-01.supports: Simultaneous CRISPR/Cas9 editing of three PPO genes reduces fruit flesh browning in eggplant.
EGG-BROWN-01.does_not_support: It does not establish which NCBI or GenBank record each SmelPPO gene corresponds to; the accessions suggested alongside it were wrong organisms.

LET-VITC-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (Gemini), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
LET-VITC-01.supports: Editing upstream open reading frames enables translational control; applied to raise ascorbate in lettuce via GGP2.
LET-VITC-01.does_not_support: It does not settle which of the two lettuce GDP-L-galactose phosphorylase genes (LOC111907963 or VTC5) is the edited one — read the paper before relying on the ID.

BRA-CLUB-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (Gemini), relayed by maintainer 2026-11-13
BRA-CLUB-01.supports: Molecular characterisation of CRa, conferring clubroot resistance in Brassica rapa; CRa mRNA deposited as AB751517.
BRA-CLUB-01.does_not_support: It covers CRa only — not CRb, Crr1 or Crr3.

TOM-FIRM-01.suggested_by: external AI suggestion (Gemini), confirmed on request by maintainer 2026-11-13
TOM-FIRM-01.supports: Targeted control of fruit softening in tomato; the intended reference for SlPL, SlPG2a and SlCEL2 per the supplier's explicit confirmation.
TOM-FIRM-01.does_not_support: Read the paper before attributing the firmness effect to all three genes equally — it is the pectate lyase work, and the other two were listed alongside it in the draft.
